import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_excel('seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx', header=None)

    if row[0]=='Invoice ID':
        header_idx=i
        break

print(cols)
# build data frame
data=[]

            rate=float(rate)

        amount=qty*rate
        data.append({'Invoice ID':inv,'District':district,'Amount':amount})
import pandas as pd
d=pd.DataFrame(data)
print(d.head())
print(d.groupby('District')['Amount'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10))
